items.q: That's all I know, if Jobetus. ... I don't know what his real name.

ctx.x: That's all I know, if Jobetus. How they become twin brothers I don't know, because one was named Cass McCord and the other was named Jobetus.
Well, as I understand it, Jobetus' real name was Ted McCord... [THEODORE JOBETUS MCCORD]
I don't know what his real name.
